provider: Figma MCP generate_image, model gpt-image-2.5-flare, file FHz1za66qbhAnzx3ygfTHa (owner-approved paid credits, 2026-11-07)
method: Each render asks for a top-down subject filling the frame on a flat #FF00FF key. scripts/bake-ruin-restorations.mjs keys and trims the magenta, fits the subject to its solid tile block from shared/sector-ruin-restorations.ts, partly matches its colour to the original floor, adds a soft shadow and clears the plot with ground sampled from the same floor. Sources are stored as WebP q95 and the bake reads exactly these files.
suffix: Rich texture, crisp detail, matching a painted world map. Any visible background must be plain solid flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key, no ground, no shadows on the background, no text, no border.
